The time when unit became active or started is printed after the "@" character.
The time the unit took to start is printed after the "+" character.

multi-user.target @2.050s
└─systemd-logind.service @1.850s +200ms
  └─basic.target @1.800s
    └─sockets.target @1.780s
      └─dbus.socket @1.750s +30ms
        └─sysinit.target @1.700s
          └─systemd-journald.service @1.450s +250ms
            └─local-fs.target @1.400s
              └─wsl-bootstrap.service @1.200s +200ms
